content.text:
The no-stock state now also shows the expired/expiring-soon count when applicable, so users can tell whether stock exists but is hidden due to expiry.

- Extracted the count query into a shared `useExpiredItemsCount` hook (react-query dedupes the request with `ExpiredItemsWarning`).
- Empty state renders "No Stock" plus the existing `expired_lots_hidden` message when count > 0; skeleton waits for the count when there are no dispensable items.
